name: com.mairwunnx/minecraft-mcp
title: Minecraft
description: Ask an AI about your Minecraft server and let it run it: players, worlds, configs, logs.

environmentVariables.name: WORLDAPI_URL
environmentVariables.description: WorldAPI base URL including /api/v1, such as http://localhost:8110/api/v1

environmentVariables.name: WORLDAPI_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A WorldAPI token; its permissions decide which tools the agent gets. Leave empty for what anonymous clients may read.

environmentVariables.name: WORLDAPI_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: 1 hides every tool that changes the server
